exposure: Subarachnoid block (SAB) for preterm cesarean section
General anesthesia (GA) for preterm cesarean section
outcome: Duration of stay in the Newborn Special Care Unit
cohort: 236 women undergoing preterm cesarean section (151 GA and 85 SAB) out of 7568 total deliveries
finding: While not significantly impacting perinatal mortality, general anesthesia for preterm cesarean section was associated with lower Apgar scores at 5 minutes compared to subarachnoid block.
mod_finding: Preterm infants delivered via cesarean section under subarachnoid block had a shorter stay in the Newborn Special Care Unit compared to those delivered under general anesthesia.
gest_age: Preterm (mean gestational ages were 33.2 ± 2.6 weeks for GA and 33.8 ± 2.2 weeks for SAB)
